With roots in the insurance industry dating back to 1918, UWIB Risk is no stranger to assisting businesses and successful families in managing their risk. Today, our team is comprised of talented and diverse individuals with decades of Risk Management experience.

Since our founding, UWIB has been known for its utilization of cutting-edge technology and automation to deliver superior speed and service to our clients.

We are intentional about anticipating and helping to overcome the hurdles that your business and your family might face. With “real world” know-how, we help you to navigate the legal and social challenges that today’s companies and wealthy families face.

In a consultative fashion, we help you to identify options and provide guidance so you can make strategically informed decisions about risk and risk transfer.
